title: Jazzy Char-Grilled Pork Hash
description: Savory, one-pot dish featuring char-grilled pork, rhubarb, and a hint of German flair, all cooked to crispy perfection in a scallop-shell vessel.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with paprika, salt, and pepper, and sear it in a hot skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the forced rhubarb to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the rhubarb is tender.
While the pork is cooking, heat the scallop shells in the oven until hot and fragrant.
To serve, place a portion of the pork and rhubarb mixture in each scallop shell, drizzle with olive oil, and serve hot.
